license_required.quote: Except as provided in ORS 701.010, a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board and possess an appropriate endorsement as provided in this section.

issuing_authority.quote: a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board

type.quote: The Construction Contractors Board is established, consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor subject to confirmation by the Senate in the manner provided by law.

degree_required.value: No degree required; key employees for commercial contractors may substitute degree for experience
degree_required.quote: A bachelor's degree in a construction-related field may substitute for up to three years of experience; a bachelor's degree or master's degree in business, finance or economics may substitute for up to two years of experience; and an associate's degree in construction or building management may substitute for up to one year of experience.

degree_level.quote: A bachelor's degree in a construction-related field may substitute for up to three years of experience

school_approval_basis.quote: A bachelor's degree in a construction-related field may substitute for up to three years of experience

credential_pegged.quote: a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board and possess an appropriate endorsement

required.quote: The Construction Contractors Board, by rule, shall impose training requirements for individuals and businesses seeking to be licensed under this chapter. The training required by the board must relate to business practices and laws affecting construction contractors.

experience_source.quote: The Construction Contractors Board, by rule, shall impose training requirements for individuals and businesses seeking to be licensed under this chapter. The training required by the board must relate to business practices and laws affecting construction contractors.

exams.name: Business practices and laws test
exams.notes: Required for most license applicants; does not apply to applicants seeking endorsement solely as a residential or commercial developer.
exams.quote: The board, by rule, shall approve a test for applicants for licensing under ORS 701.046. The test shall measure the applicant's knowledge regarding business practices and laws that are the subject of the training required under subsection (1) of this section.

interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years from the date of issuance unless the license is revoked or suspended as set forth in ORS 701.098.

required.quote: to qualify for the renewal of a residential contractor license the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal.

hours_per_period.quote: to qualify for the renewal of a residential contractor license the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal.

period_years.quote: to qualify for the renewal of a residential contractor license the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal.

value: laws, regulations and business practices (3 hours)
topical_requirements.quote: Three of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education regarding laws, regulations and business practices. ... Five of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education from approved providers and be courses the board has approved as continuing education regarding one or more of the following: Construction business practices. Marketing. Customer service. Accounting. Business law. Bidding. Building codes. Safety. Energy efficiency. Trade specific subjects

available.quote: If the administrator determines that the standards, qualifications and examinations for licensing or registration of building trades and mechanical and specialty skills of another state are substantially similar to the standards, qualifications and examinations required under applicable Oregon statutes and rules administered by the agency as specified in ORS 455.100, the administrator with approval of the designated examining or advisory board may, when it is in the best interest of the economy of the State of Oregon, enter into a reciprocal agreement with such other state to issue without examination licenses or certificate of registration upon proof of licensing or registration in such other state and upon payment of appropriate fees.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 670 - Occupations and Professions Generally

requirements.value: Standards, qualifications and examinations of the other state must be substantially similar to Oregon's; applicant must provide proof of licensing or registration in the other state and pay appropriate fees.
requirements.quote: enter into a reciprocal agreement with such other state to issue without examination licenses or certificate of registration upon proof of licensing or registration in such other state and upon payment of appropriate fees.
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 670 - Occupations and Professions Generally

title_protection.quote: Violation of ORS 701.021 is a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of ORS chapter 701.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a rule or order of the Construction Contractors Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered into a settlement agreement but failed to comply with its terms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into a settlement agreement with another person under ORS 701.145 but failed to comply with the terms of the settlement agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Owner, officer, or partner of a business entity subject to prior revocation, suspension, or civil/criminal penalty related to construction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a business entity or is the owner, director, officer or partner of a business entity or of a reorganized business entity, as defined in ORS 305.330, that was subject to a revocation or suspension of a license, or subject to a civil or criminal penalty, imposed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitted an application that was incomplete in a material respect or included an incorrect or misleading statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitted an application to the board that, at the time the board issued or renewed the license or denied the application, was incomplete in any material respect or included a statement that was incorrect or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money causing a lien to be filed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to a person and the failure caused the person to file a lien on a structure under ORS 87.001 to 87.093.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly provided false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly provided false information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint being filed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint being filed with the board under ORS 701.139.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked together with another contractor on the same task on the same job site in excess of allowed exempt combinations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked together with another contractor on the same task on the same job site, where one of the contractors was classed as exempt under ORS 701.035 (2)(b) and the number of contractors working together exceeded the following: (A) Two sole proprietors; (B) One partnership; (C) One corporation; or (D) One limited liability company.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of specified serious crimes including murder, assault, kidnapping, rape, arson, robbery, theft, or extortion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Was convicted, or an owner, director, officer or partner of the licensee or applicant was convicted, consistent with ORS 670.280, of one of the following crimes in this state or an equivalent crime in another state: (A) Murder; (B) Assault in the first degree; (C) Kidnapping; (D) Rape, sodomy or unlawful sexual penetration; (E) Sexual abuse; (F) Arson in the first degree; (G) Robbery in the first degree; (H) Theft in the first degree; or (I) Extortion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay another person for labor or materials under a public improvement contract within 90 days of receiving payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Did not pay another person for supplying labor or materials contracted for under a public improvement contract, plus the amount of interest due, within 90 days after receiving payment from a contracting agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and injurious to the public welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and that the board finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hired employees while licensed as exempt from the nonexempt class.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used workers supplied by a worker leasing company while licensed as exempt.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used one or more workers supplied by a worker leasing company while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.

bonding_required.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a contractor license shall file with the Construction Contractors Board a surety bond with one or more corporate sureties authorized to do business in this state in the amount set forth in ORS 701.081 or 701.084.

insurance_required.quote: A contractor who possesses a license as required under this chapter shall have in effect public liability, personal injury and property damage insurance covering the work of the contractor that is subject to this chapter

definition_quote.value: A person that, for compensation or with the intent to sell, arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate, or to do any part thereof.
definition_quote.quote: A person that, for compensation or with the intent to sell, arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate, or to do any part thereof.

methods_authorized.quote: arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: Every person submitting a bid or a written estimate of the costs to construct building sewer piping shall provide to potential customers, prior to an agreement to perform, the following: (a) The person's Construction Contractors Board license number

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: A residential general contractor shall: ... Obtain general liability insurance under ORS 701.073 in an amount of not less than $500,000

contract_must_be_written.quote: A contractor may not perform work to construct, improve or repair a residential structure or zero-lot-line dwelling for a property owner without a written contract if the aggregate contract price exceeds $2,000.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: A property owner who enters into an initial written contract for the construction, improvement or repair of a residential structure or zero-lot-line dwelling on real property owned by the property owner may cancel the contract by delivery of a written notice of cancellation anytime prior to 12 midnight at the end of the next business day.

deposit_cap_fraction.quote: the contractor offers to perform a home improvement, accepts a deposit of more than 50 percent of the total contract price

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: A contract described in this section may contain a provision requiring mediation or arbitration of a dispute arising from the contract.

value: clause making contract subject to laws of another state
clause requiring litigation or arbitration in another state
clause prohibiting suspension of performance or termination for nonpayment
voidable_contract_clauses.quote: A construction contract may not include any provision, covenant or clause that: (a) Makes the construction contract subject to the laws of another state or that requires any litigation, arbitration or other dispute resolution proceeding arising from the construction contract to be conducted in another state; or (b) States that a party to the construction contract cannot suspend performance under the construction contract or terminate the construction contract if another party to the construction contract fails to make prompt payments

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: A person working on one structure or project, under one or more contracts, when the aggregate price of all of that person's contracts for labor, materials and all other items is less than $1,000 and such work is of a casual, minor or inconsequential nature.

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: The provisions of this chapter are exclusive and a city, county or other political subdivision may not require or issue any registrations, licenses or surety bonds, nor charge any fee for the regulatory or surety registration of any contractor licensed with the board.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years from the date of issuance unless the license is revoked or suspended as set forth in ORS 701.098.
